enriched.title: Vocabulário e Expressões para Trabalho e Situações Cotidianas
enriched.summary: A aula aborda vocabulário relacionado a trabalho e situações do dia a dia, incluindo termos como 'headache', 'support' e expressões como 'I can’t stand this anymore'. Também foca na pronúncia e utilizações práticas dos termos apresentados.
mainTopics: Expressões úteis para o dia a dia

vocabulary.definition: Pain or discomfort in the head or upper neck area.
examples: I have a terrible headache today.
She took a pill for her headache.

vocabulary.definition: A severe headache, often accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light and sound.
examples: He can't work today because of a migraine.
Migraines can be triggered by stress.

vocabulary.definition: Happening one after another without a break.
examples: We have back-to-back meetings today.
The team won back-to-back games.

vocabulary.definition: A person who rescues someone or something from danger or difficulty.
examples: He was seen as the savior of the company.
She thanked her savior for helping during the crisis.

vocabulary.definition: To give assistance or encouragement to someone or something.
examples: I support your decision.
They need financial support to continue the project.
The constant noise was very annoying.
He has an annoying habit of interrupting.
She felt weak after the long workout.
The argument was weak and unconvincing.

grammar.explanation: Use 'because of' to indicate the reason for something.
rules: 'Because of' is followed by a noun or pronoun.
It cannot be followed by a complete clause.
examples: He missed the meeting because of a headache.
Because of the rain, the event was canceled.
commonMistakes: Using 'because of' with a full clause (e.g., 'because of it was raining' is incorrect).

expressions.usage: Used to express frustration or inability to tolerate something.
examples: I can't stand this heat anymore!
She can't stand his behavior anymore.

expressions.usage: Used to describe something happening continuously throughout the day.
examples: He worked all day long to finish the project.
They played video games all day long.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: I missed the meeting ______ a headache.
practiceQuestions.explanation: 'Because of' is used to indicate the reason for missing the meeting.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate to English: 'Eu não aguento mais isso.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: This is a direct translation of the expression taught in class.

culturalNotes: Expressing frustration like 'I can't stand this anymore' is common in informal conversations.
Work-related terms like 'corporate farce' are often used critically in professional settings.
studyTips: Practice pronouncing new vocabulary in front of a mirror to improve fluency.
Use flashcards to memorize the vocabulary and expressions presented in the class.
originalExamples: I can’t stand this anymore. (Não aguento mais isso.)
This information wasn’t taught. (Essa informação não foi ensinada.)
He missed the meeting because of a headache. (Ele perdeu a reunião por causa de uma dor de cabeça.)
